response.sql: SELECT s.insurstat AS insurance_status, COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref) AS conserved_sites, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref)) OVER () AS share FROM scanconservation c JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY s.insurstat

assumptions.assumption: "Conserved sites" means distinct sites that have at least one conservation record, so each site is counted once however many records it has.
A NULL insurstat forms its own group, which GROUP BY does by default. The share is computed in floating point with no rounding.

alternatives.interpretation: Count conservation records instead of distinct sites, so a site with several records is counted several times.
alternatives.sql: SELECT s.insurstat AS insurance_status, COUNT(*) AS conserved_sites, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share FROM scanconservation c JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY s.insurstat
